operators.name: embedding_gt_forward
semantics: For each index i in indices, output[i] = weight[i] > threshold (elementwise comparison)
padding_idx is handled according to nn.Embedding semantics: weight[padding_idx] is ignored for gradient, but forward lookup still produces weight[padding_idx]; comparison still applies.
Output dtype is bool, device cuda.
Indices are expected to be in [0, num_embeddings-1].
self.embedding(x) performs embedding lookup: output shape [batch_size, seq_len, embedding_dim], dtype float32, device cuda (input x moved to cuda first).
torch.gt compares embedding output with 0.5 elementwise, producing boolean tensor of same shape.
